visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A dark, high-contrast monochrome illustration depicting an older man with white hair standing against a brick wall. He is looking upward and to the side, holding a long, thin object like a cane or a pole. Above him, a dark, indistinct silhouette of a figure is visible near a window or opening. The style is that of a 19th-century ink or charcoal drawing with heavy shadows.
visualDescription.visualObjectsEn: Brick wall, window or rectangular opening, cane or pole, clothing (coat), dark silhouette.
visualDescription.recognizableCharactersOrPeopleEn: An elderly man with white hair and a beard; a second, indistinct shadowy figure.
visualDescription.uncertaintyNotes: The exact nature of the object the man is holding is unclear, as is the identity of the shadowy figure above him. The medium appears to be an engraving or a dark wash drawing, but the specific technique is not definitively identifiable from the image.
